role: Offline regeneration of per-sample DFA α1 for an archived workout from its stored RR series, mirroring the live analyzer's 120 s window / 20 s cadence / artifact gate, and mapping readings back onto WorkoutSamples; declines paused workouts, whose active-second samples cannot be aligned with the wall-clock readings without the (unstored) pause timeline.
types: WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer.Reading: struct — offsetSec, alpha1, fitQualityR2, cadenceSec (how long it stays current)

flags.text: No test in EmuquTests references WorkoutAlpha1Reanalyzer; its only caller is the post-summary 'Re-analyze α1' path (FitnessPostSummaryView+Cards.swift:859/863), which overwrites archived α1 samples.

units.does: Returns no readings for a paused workout (wasPaused: samples end more than one cadence step short of the wall-clock duration — readings are on the wall-clock beat timeline, samples on active seconds, and the pause timeline is not stored). Otherwise re-stamps the session's RR points on the gap-corrected timeline and sweeps a windowSec (120 s) window every cadenceSec (20 s) from t = windowSec to session duration, fitting α1 on each window; returns the readings that passed the fit gates, each carrying cadenceSec.

branches.cond: no RR series, fewer than minBeatsForFit (64) points, or wasPaused

branches.effect: duration = last gap-corrected t_ms / 1000 (0 if timeline empty)
fit one window per cadence tick
append it; else the window is skipped

units.does: True when the session's wall-clock duration exceeds its last WorkoutSample.offsetSec (active seconds) by more than toleranceSec, i.e. the workout spent that long paused; logs the shortfall. False without an end date or samples.
Maps each RR point to a copy whose t_ms is the gap-corrected wall-clock offset.

Fits α1 for one window: requires >= minBeatsForFit beats, cleans RR with LiveDFAAnalyzer.cleanRRForDFA, rejects when correctedFraction > LiveDFAAnalyzer.maxCorrectedFraction or DFA fails; returns Reading(offsetSec: Int(t), alpha1, R², cadenceSec).

branches.cond: corrected fraction above threshold or DFAAnalyzer.compute returns nil

units.does: Sorts readings by offset and, for each sample in any order, finds the latest reading at or before it by binary search (latestReading); sets the sample's alpha1 to it when it is less than that reading's own cadenceSec old, else clears alpha1 to nil. Returns samples unchanged when readings is empty.

branches.cond: no reading at/before the sample, or it is >= its cadenceSec older
branches.effect: sample alpha1 cleared to nil; else set to that reading's alpha1

units.does: Binary search over readings sorted by offsetSec for the last one with offsetSec <= offset; nil when all are later.

branches.effect: narrows to the first reading after offset
